name: design-consultation
conclusion_quantitative: design-consultation (Ask) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 10+ autonomy limits, 10+ clarification rules, 10+ approval gates, 3 validation rules, 10+ escalation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: design-consultation builds a complete design system for a product, from product context and competitive research to a proposal, mockups and a written DESIGN.md (gstack). Its shared preamble asks about setup choices and gets a yes before upgrades, syncing or other skills, while spawned sessions decide alone. The design work is a dialogue: the user chooses what to do with an existing design, approves the proposal and always has the final say. Mockups pass a self-check before being shown, and research or reviewer failures are reported to the user.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ autonomy limits (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 5 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, 5 tied to a situation, mostly running text. The front matter limits the agent to `Bash`, `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Glob`, `Grep`, `AskUserQuestion` and `WebSearch`. From the shared gstack preamble: when proactive mode is off it does not start or suggest skills on its own; spawned sessions skip setup prompts and pick the recommended option; when it cannot ask the user it must not decide silently; the sync question never blocks the skill; and it auto-commits only in continuous checkpoint mode, pushing only when that is on.

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ escalation rules (9 mandatory, 1 advisory; 6 conditional), mostly prose.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), 9 strict and 1 counted as a suggestion (it contains "consider"), 6 tied to a situation, mostly running text. Without a way to ask the user the skill is blocked and waits. The agent stops when going in circles, flags anything that looks wrong, reports concerns and blockers, and escalates after 3 failures, on security doubts or unverifiable work. It notes sites it could not research, tells the user about outside-reviewer login failures or outages, and flags incoherent overrides without blocking.

statements.quote: **If no AskUserQuestion variant appears in your tool list, this skill is BLOCKED.** Stop, report `BLOCKED — AskUserQuestion unavailable`, and wait for the user.

**BLOCKED** — cannot proceed; state blocker and what was tried.
